RUNG 4 partially worked; the row needs RUNG 5 to finish. Zero searches, English (the congress runs in English). Route: eeassoc.org/congress -> /events/eea-esem-dublin-2026 -> the congress site https://www.eea-esem-congresses.org/ , whose /full-programme is a server-rendered Drupal Views TABLE of sessions with columns Title, Presenter(s), Type, Field, Date, Time, Length, Room - 45 session rows per page, each linking /sessions/<slug>. Each session page lists its papers as views-row blocks, printed twice (papers-detail and papers-syllabus), so papers are counted as DISTINCT titles per session. Fetched all 45 sessions on the first page: 209 distinct papers, 205 of them in the 38 'Contributed Sessions'. THE WALL: the pager is a query string, and Cloudflare challenges EVERY query-string URL on this host while serving the bare path fine - https://www.eea-esem-congresses.org/full-programme returns HTTP 200 / 255,091 bytes, while /full-programme?page=1, ?page=2, ?items_per_page=5000 and ?items_per_page=All all return HTTP 403 with a 'Just a moment...' interstitial, with or without a cookie jar seeded from the base page, a Referer and full browser headers. The Drupal views AJAX endpoint (view_name=full_programme, display page_1, POSTed to /views/ajax) returns a Drupal 403 access-denied page. There is no sitemap.xml (404) to enumerate session slugs another way, and the congress S3 bucket eea-congress-files.s3.eu-west-3.amazonaws.com is not listable (AccessDenied), so the 'PDF Programme' the nav advertises could not be located by path. The /presenters view has the same problem: 80 presenters per page across pages 0-13 (~1,120 presenters), pagination equally blocked. NEXT ACTION (rung 5, orchestrator): open https://www.eea-esem-congresses.org/full-programme in Playwright, which clears a Cloudflare interstitial, and page through ?page=1 .. ?page=7 collecting the /sessions/<slug> links (45 per page); the session pages themselves need no browser and can then be counted by the distinct-title rule above. A quicker alternative is the 'PDF Programme' menu item on that site, whose link target is not exposed in the server-rendered HTML. ABSENCE OF A FULL COUNT IS NOT EVIDENCE THIS MEETING IS SMALL: one eighth of the programme already carries 209 papers.
